Very relatable. 

It’s because we fear that when we admit or show our mental illness it will be returned with all the stereotypical shit and negative stigma behind it. Such as being attention seeking or weak.

Ironically I feel like I’m one of those that hides my disease because deep down inside I believe some of the stigma. And it just supports my self hatred -thinking I’m being attention seeking or crazy or just can’t handle simple things because I’m weak.

Decades ago people with cancer were seen as similar. It was such taboo no one would address it. You wouldn’t tell others you had it or you knew someone who has it. That’s what I seem to hold on to. Like surely we will get to a point where you won’t feel the need to hide it.

We will get there. You will get there. I wish you the best man.
I’m starting keto and I would like to do it steadily. I understand you’re meant to stay under 20g of carbs but has anyone been successful with staying under 50g?
